source: Pantina & Furst, PRL 94, 138301 (2005) — Elasticity and Critical Bending Moment of Model Colloidal Aggregates

lessons.claim: A single colloidal bond sustains a torque -- a tangential interaction is real. It is not reproduced by a central pair potential (DLVO included). 3-point bending: κ₀=64±0.5 mN/m @10mM MgCl₂, the JKR prediction 80 mN/m, a_c≈40nm, M_c≈35 pN·µm

not_verified: not reproduced with our own simulation (tier 2)
